name: Akshika Wijesundara
bio:
Akshika Wijesundara is a third year undergraduate of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Moratuwa. His interest fields are mobile app development, machine learning, artificial intelligence, image processing and embedded systems. Apart from his academics, he is a Google Student Ambassador for South East Asia where he acts as the liaison for Google and he is a contributor to OpenMRS Open Source Project.

He is passionate about public speaking.

Above all, he is a fun person to be with ;)
